title: Wedding Couple
author: litcyz
description:
Floral Heart Embrace Wedding Couple Machine Embroidery Design 🧵💍
Celebrate everlasting love and delicate romance with this breathtaking floral heart wedding couple machine embroidery design! 💍🌸✨
Featuring an intimate line-art illustration of a bride and groom embracing, framed by a soft heart-shaped motif formed by winding green vines, leaf tendrils, and pop-of-red floral blossoms. This artistic bridal artwork brings an exquisite, boutique aesthetic to wedding keepsakes, ring bearer pillows, bridal jackets, anniversary gifts, custom tote bags, or linen handkerchiefs.
Frame life's most romantic moments in stitched perfection today! 🥂💖
